---
title: "Library - Quests"
format: html
---

```{r}
#| warning: false
#| echo: false

library(DBI)
library(RSQLite)
library(dplyr)
library(jsonlite)

# Connect to database
con <- DBI::dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), "../../asset/demonax-test.sqlite")

quests <- dbReadTable(con, "quests")
items <- dbReadTable(con, "items")

DBI::dbDisconnect(con)

# Generate clickable map links from chest location strings
generate_map_link <- function(chest_location) {
  if (is.na(chest_location) || chest_location == "" || chest_location == "NA") {
    return("")
  }

  # Parse format: "32605,31908,3 (1018-0997-03)" or just "32605,31908,3"
  # Extract just the coordinate part before any parenthesis
  coords_part <- trimws(strsplit(chest_location, "\\(")[[1]][1])
  parts <- strsplit(coords_part, ",")[[1]]

  if (length(parts) != 3) {
    # Return original string if parsing fails
    return(chest_location)
  }

  x <- trimws(parts[1])
  y <- trimws(parts[2])
  z <- trimws(parts[3])

  # Validate numeric
  if (is.na(as.numeric(x)) || is.na(as.numeric(y)) || is.na(as.numeric(z))) {
    return(chest_location)
  }

  # Default zoom level 5 (detailed view for quest chests)
  zoom <- 5

  # Generate hash for map navigation
  hash <- sprintf("#%s,%s,%s,%d?crosshair=1&quests=1", x, y, z, zoom)
  url <- sprintf("/map/index.html%s", hash)

  # Return HTML link with "Show on map" text
  return(sprintf('<a href="%s" style="color: #004294; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 500;">Show on map</a>',
                 url))
}

# Read quest CSV for descriptions
quest_csv <- read.csv("../../asset/csv/quest.csv")

# Aggregate quests by name and parse rewards
quest_summary <- quests |>
  group_by(name) |>
  summarize(
    chest_locations = paste(chest_location, collapse = "; "),
    reward_items_json_list = list(reward_items_json),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Parse reward IDs for each quest
quest_summary$all_reward_ids <- lapply(quest_summary$reward_items_json_list, function(json_list) {
  unique(unlist(lapply(json_list, function(json_str) {
    tryCatch(fromJSON(json_str), error = function(e) integer(0))
  })))
})

# Get reward item names
quest_summary$reward_items <- sapply(quest_summary$all_reward_ids, function(ids) {
  if(length(ids) > 0) {
    names <- items$name[items$type_id %in% ids]
    paste(unique(names), collapse = ", ")
  } else {
    ""
  }
})

# Join with CSV for descriptions
quest_data_all <- quest_summary |>
  left_join(
    quest_csv |>
      group_by(quest_name) |>
      summarize(
        description = first(quest_legend),
        level_rec = first(level_rec),
        wiki_link = first(link),
        quest_value = first(quest_value),
        .groups = "drop"
      ),
    by = c("name" = "quest_name")
  ) |>
  mutate(
    Name = name,
    Description = ifelse(is.na(description) | description == "", "", description),
    `Recommended level` = ifelse(is.na(level_rec) | level_rec == "", "", as.character(level_rec)),
    `Reward locations` = sapply(chest_locations, function(locs) {
      if (is.na(locs) || locs == "") return("")

      # Handle multiple locations (semicolon-separated)
      locations <- strsplit(locs, "; ")[[1]]
      links <- sapply(locations, generate_map_link)
      paste(links, collapse = "; ")
    }),
    Rewards = reward_items,
    `Wiki` = ifelse(is.na(wiki_link) | wiki_link == "", "",
                         paste0('<a href="', wiki_link, '" target="_blank">Wiki</a>')),
    quest_value = quest_value
  )
```

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Original

```{r}
#| warning: false
#| echo: false

# Filter for Original quests (quest_value <= 332)
quest_data_original <- quest_data_all |>
  filter(!is.na(quest_value) & quest_value <= 332) |>
  select(Name, Description, `Recommended level`, `Reward locations`, Rewards, `Wiki`) |>
  arrange(Name)

DT::datatable(quest_data_original,
          options = list(
            pageLength = 25,
            searching = TRUE,
            ordering = TRUE,
            columnDefs = list(
              list(width = '150px', targets = 0),
              list(width = '200px', targets = 1),
              list(width = '80px', targets = 2)
            )
          ),
          rownames = FALSE,
          escape = FALSE)
```
